source.scope: Matched baseline/candidate instrumented exports on one Windows runner. Each action starts a new process. Retained and Load use the same r1-baseline-fresh profile after real manual Save and Autosave. Verbose engine logging is enabled equally to identify shutdown resources. OS caches are not cleared.

scope: Four matched Load samples per variant, AB/BA/AB/BA on one Windows runner. Request callbacks, refresh executions and History projections are counted separately. Observer capture/hash is outside first-Accept frame scope and separately timed; inherited complete Load-to-response latencies remain observer-inclusive. Lightweight first-draw session capture is separately timed inside Load. Polling, text checks and matched counter bookkeeping still contribute observer overhead to frame intervals. Next 28 natural reading actions grow genuine History to 30 captions; each waits native completion before one real press/release. Observed drawing intervals can include one observation frame. Spans are inclusive and overlap; do not sum nested costs. No uncompiled passage, choice, board, locale change or long-history saved Load is timed. Screenshots retain the inherited first-Accept view before subsequent reading. Natural reveal waits are outside each subsequent input interval. Four samples are descriptive, not a device guarantee.
